Every flip re-verified by eye on the 300-dpi renders by the conductor (anti-poisoning probe: p.202 render regenerated from the sha256-pinned PDF is byte-identical). Compiler input for scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py — the false-friend detach pattern: per_skala -> [] + PRESERVE the contaminated block under the disputed key + corroborated _data_note + honest-gap intel_2026.whatYouNeed. NEVER authors a replacement licensing value (rule #9 / rule #4 detach>plausible-remap). None of these 13 codes is present in kbli-gold-all.json (verified 2026-07-18). pma_status / l4_bali / TKA facets are NOT touched and NOT asserted in any note (P1-v2 abstain fail-safe, plan §8 A-1).

Calibration pins: canonical blob 3cfe8134d (content-authoritative per plan §8 A-3), vault manifest e7d25a37, membership aa0a0a69. codes.judul: Perburuan, Penangkapan, dan Kegiatan Jasa Terkait
codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 01700 absorbs SIX KBLI-2020 codes (01711, 01712, 01713, 01714, 01715, 01719 — taxon-specific hunting/capture), image-verified on BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 p.134 (six consecutive rows all mapping to 01700). Its served per_skala (2 rows) was inherited from pp28_sources=['01711'] ALONE — a single-ancestor inherit on a 6-way merge. The recorded PP28 absence hunt (pp28/ABSENT.json, 21 lampiran files scanned) covers the declared ancestor 01711 only — the other five ancestors and 01700 itself have no recorded hunt, so no claim is made here about their PP28 presence (cross-family refuter finding, 2026-07-18). An aggregate activity cannot inherit one taxon's licensing row wholesale. per_skala detached; the licensing regime applicable to the merged 2025 scope is not retrievable from the pinned sources as hunted. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.

codes.judul: Benefisiasi atau Peningkatan Kualitas Batu Bara
codes.data_note: KBLI 2020 code 05100 'Pertambangan Batu Bara' SPLITS into 2025 codes {05101 extraction, 05102 beneficiation}, image-verified on BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 p.144. The single served per_skala row came from pp28_sources=['05100'] — PP 28/2025 Lampiran I.D p.202 row 24 (render image-verified at D6; regenerated from the sha256-pinned PDF byte-identically): an end-to-end mining-CONCESSION regime (IUP Tahap Kegiatan Eksplorasi, RKAB, Laporan Akhir Eksplorasi, Studi Kelayakan; Kewenangan Menteri/Kepala Badan) filed under the pre-split code. 05102's uraian explicitly EXCLUDES mining ('tidak mencakup aktivitas pertambangan batu bara … lihat kelompok 05101') and requires beneficiation be conducted 'secara terpisah dari proses pertambangan batu bara'. A standalone beneficiation operator would not plausibly hold a mining-concession IUP; the regime does not transfer. per_skala detached (D5 blind refutation + conductor D6 concur). BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b; PP28 394933 sha 8ad5155a.

Found by the blind cross-family extractor (GLM 5.2) 2026-07-18; conductor-verified on the canonical payload and the vault ABSENT record. Rule #9: a licensing value without a verifiable locator cannot be certified — per_skala detached, preserved under the disputed key for audit; a future image-grade lampiran sweep may restore it WITH provenance. No claim is made that the regime is wrong for lignite mining — only that its cited source cannot be verified. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.

codes.judul: Industri Produk dari Pencampuran Hasil Kilang Minyak Bumi dengan Biofuel
codes.data_note: KBLI 2020 code 19291 'Industri Produk Dari Hasil Kilang Minyak Bumi' SPLITS into 2025 codes {19205 'Industri Briket' (also absorbing 19292), 19206 'Industri Produk dari Pencampuran Hasil Kilang Minyak Bumi dengan Biofuel', 19209 'Industri Produk Lainnya dari Hasil Kilang Minyak Bumi'}, image-verified in BOTH crosswalk directions (BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 printed p.140 / PDF p.154; Lampiran 10 PDF p.347). The served per_skala was lifted verbatim from the generic pre-split 19291 row (PP28 Lampiran I.F row No.187, image-verified on the 300-dpi render of PDF 394937 p.525): that page carries ONLY the Kecil/Menengah block (Menengah Rendah, 'NIB dan Sertifikat Standar', Otomatis, three location-keyed kewenangan tiers) — the served Besar row (Tinggi, 'NIB dan Izin') is not retrievable from the pinned sources as hunted, and the canonical's status_mapping 'CODICE_RINUMERATO' is contradicted by the image-verified three-way split. Detached under the plan's preregistered divergence rule: two independent cross-family seats (Codex refuter dissent; blind GLM extractor, needs_quarantine=true) flagged the cross-vintage generic payload against the conductor's initial clean, and the conductor could not affirmatively certify the pre-split basket payload for this blending-specific 2025 code. per_skala detached; no replacement authored.
